title: Germany news: Campaigns wrap up in two state elections
summary: Parties are campaigning for a last day ahead of polls in Mecklenburg-Vorpomerania and Berlin. And an association responsible for German sea ports says they are at high risk from cyberattacks and…

image.caption: State elections in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and Berlin are being closely watchedImage: INSIDE-PICTURE/picture alliance

blocks.text: Parties are campaigning for a last day ahead of polls in Mecklenburg-Vorpomerania and Berlin. And an association responsible for German sea ports says they are at high risk from cyberattacks and sabotage. DW has more.

blocks.caption: State elections in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and Berlin are being closely watchedImage: INSIDE-PICTURE/picture alliance

items: Elections campaigns are closing in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and Berlin ahead of elections on Sunday
The elections are particularly in the spotlight as a gauge of the strength of the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party, which won a recent state election by a landslide
A port union has warned that seaports are at significant risk of cyberattacks and sabotage
The famous Oktoberfest opens in the Bavarian capital, Munich
Annual anti-abortion marches are to take place in Berlin and Cologne, with some Catholic bishops expected to participate

Oktoberfest set to begin in Munich

blocks.caption: Oktoberfest attracts millions of visitors every yearImage: Wolfgang Maria Weber/IMAGO

blocks.text: The world-famous Oktoberfest will kick off in Munich on Saturday with a traditional ceremony where the city's mayor taps a first barrel of beer — the liquid focus of the event.
New Munich Mayor Dominik Krause of the Green Party will open the 191st edition on the Theresienwiese festival grounds in the center of the Bavarian city at noon (1000 GMT).
